posts.title: Microsoft To Do fan? I’ve got (bad) news for ya…
posts.description: Yesterday it was announced that Microsoft was killing off one of it’s best apps, To Do: "Microsoft is killing its great tasks app in favor of its worse tasks app". This is a real bummer as the app is easily one of the best I’ve seen.
